messages:
marta: FYI — shiproom wants a concise plan for fencing traffic during next model swap for EU private tenants. Need to settle canary slices, decay budgets, and fallback ownership by EOD.
jiro: Do we have a suggested exposure budget? i.e., % of tenants + autoscale window
samir: My initial thought: 5% tenants for 2h, then 15% for 6h if signals look good. Keep a 30m warmup with reduced concurrency.
ellie: Agree on phased exposure. Also propose a soft-fallback variant (quantized model) rather than full shutoff to preserve UX.
ops-bot: incident-policy reminder: any rollout that may affect >1% latency SLA needs oncall in the loop and runbook attached :bell:
priya: For private EU, we need KMS key rotation checks before canary start. Ops: can you confirm timing?
ops-bot: scheduled-task: kms-rotation-check will run at 1716664380 — report if any failures.
jiro: If KMS check fails, automatic hold and notify #eng-oncall. Who's owning the hold logic? @samir?
samir: I can own the hold logic. I'll add a feature-flag gate that looks at kms_ok && telemetry_ok.
ellie: Flag proto snippet:
```
flags.model_swap.euvox_gate: {
  exposure_fraction: 0.05,
  warmup_mins: 30,
  auto_bump: [0.15 after 2h],
  fallback_variant: "quantized-v2",
  kill_switch: true
}
```
marta: Nice. Two questions: 1) telemetry_ok definition? 2) rollback SLA (how fast we can kill traffic)
samir: telemetry_ok = no tail-latency > 2x baseline, error rate < +0.5% over 15m, and token-failure < 0.1%. Kill switch = immediate global flag flip, aim for <60s to full rollback.
jiro: We'll need a small A/B eval on few churn-sensitive customers to validate hallucination/regression before auto-bump. Who's coordinating eval sets?
ellie: I'll pull 10 small sample prompts + 5 customer-specific prompts from evals team. Will run shadowing during warmup window.
priya: Ops note: for EU private we cannot route traffic outside region. Keep all canary instances in eu-central and mark routing policy no-evac.
marta: Good call. Also legal asked to log tenant consent where customer opted into early access — include opt-in tag in metrics.
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: canary pipeline triggers require 2 approvals: product + security. Use /deploy canary --requires-approvals
samir: Action items:
- samir: implement flag gate + kill-switch (owner)
- ellie: produce eval set + run shadow tests (owner)
- ops: confirm KMS pre-check + routing constraints (owner)
- product (marta): prepare shiproom summary + approval thread
Timeline: start KMS check at 1716664380, warmup target 1716664620, candidate auto-bump window 2h after warmup.
marta: Thanks. I'll capture this in the shiproom notes and ping approvals. If anyone has objections to the 5%->15% cadence, speak now :thumbsup: or share concerns.
jiro: :thumbsup:
ellie: :thumbsup:
priya: small ask — add observability tag tenant.optin=true so we can filter metrics easily.
samir: will do.
marta: Great. Closing thread and moving to shiproom doc. If anything changes, reopen here.
